inputs.text: This isn’t just a report on the conflict between the United States, Israel, and Iran—it’s a carefully managed story about how much escalation the public will accept. The focus on civilian areas and threatened infrastructure makes the danger visible, while the talk of “just war” gives powerful actors a moral framework to justify whatever comes next. I don’t buy that the risk of a wider conflict is merely an unfortunate possibility; the way these events are framed suggests the public is being prepared to see escalation as inevitable.
